notes: Account background: enterprise CCaaS provider with multi-tenant hosted offering and ~1.2k global agents.
Driver: improve live-agent time-to-resolution using real-time agent-assist + auto-summaries to reduce wrap time.
POC scope: real-time tool-calling for CRM actions (create ticket, update owner), inline suggested replies, end-of-call auto-summary.
Performance targets: p99 latency < 250ms for streaming assistant responses; sustained throughput for 1k concurrent agents, burst to 3k+ during marketing events.
Cost sensitivity: wants to cap token spend per agent; exploring Optimize recommendations and quantized model variants for tail requests.
Security asks: customer-owned KMS, audit logs retained 12 months, EU data residency for EU tenant, SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning.
Quote from VP Product: "We need predictable behavior during Black Friday-style spikes — fallback must be automatic and non-disruptive."
Integration notes: current stack Zendesk + Twilio + internal orchestration. Wants Redwood to call back to internal ticket API (tool-calling) — need sign-off on connector auth flow.
POC success metrics: 20% reduction in average handle time, 15% increase in first-contact resolution for scripted intents, <10% false-action rate on tool calls.
Open items: EU deployment diagram, VPC peering / egress rules, SLA addendum, pricing for dedicated burst nodes.
summary: Late-stage expansion: existing Redwood customer exploring enterprise-grade contact center workloads. Procurement stage, focused on private/VPC deployment in EU, dedicated burst capacity, and strict security controls. POC shows promising latency; procurement/legal and security sign-offs are primary blockers. Next: finalize SOW and SLA addition for burst guarantees.
